subject: Banking
title: The Float and Free Money
description: A fast breakdown of The Float and Free Money for builders.

hook.text: When clearing took 3-5 days, the money existed in two places at once. The writer's account and the depositor's bank.

buildup.text: This gap is called float. During float, the money is technically uncollected but often already available to spend.

discovery.text: Banks earned interest on float. Billions of dollars sitting in transit generated free income for financial institutions.

twist.text: Check 21 digitized clearing in 2004, shrinking float from days to hours. Banks lost billions in float income overnight.

climax.text: Float was a hidden subsidy that funded banking for centuries. Faster payments destroyed it.

punchline.text: Money in two places at once. Float was banking's secret income.

quiz.question: What is 'float' in check processing?
options: The time gap where money exists in two accounts during clearing

details.summary: The float is the period between when a payment is initiated and when it actually settles, during which the money exists in limbo. Banks and corporations earn billions annually by investing these temporarily idle funds.
details.whyItMatters: Float was once a massive profit center for banks and payment processors. As real-time payments eliminate float, the financial industry must find new revenue models to replace this hidden income stream.
takeaways: Float exists whenever settlement is slower than authorization
Banks historically earned billions investing float overnight
Real-time payment systems are eliminating float revenue

faq.question: How did check float benefit consumers historically?
faq.answer: People would write checks knowing funds were not yet in their account, relying on the 2 to 5 day clearing period to deposit money before the check settled. This kiting practice was common but technically illegal.

faq.question: Is float still a significant source of income for banks?
faq.answer: Decreasingly. Same-day ACH, real-time payments, and electronic check images have dramatically shortened clearing times. Float income from traditional sources has shrunk, though some float remains in international transfers.
